set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME"
printf 'OS='; cat /etc/redhat-release
printf 'KERNEL='; uname -r
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'SELINUX='; getenforce
printf 'FAILED_UNITS='; systemctl --failed --no-legend | grep -c . || true
printf 'CLIENT_PACKAGE='; rpm -q openldap-clients
printf 'FIREWALL_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active firewalld
printf 'LDAP_LISTENER_COUNT='; ss -lnt | grep -Ec ':(389|636)[[:space:]]' || true
printf 'FILE_SECURITY\n'; stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /root/ldap-directory-reader.credentials /etc/openldap/certs/hrprivacy-ca.crt /srv/legacy2/ldap-attribute-privacy/hr.ldif
printf 'SOURCE_SHA256='; sha256sum /srv/legacy2/ldap-attribute-privacy/hr.ldif | awk '{print $1}'
if grep -qxF "$CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY" /root/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null; then printf 'TEMP_TRANSFER_KEY=UNEXPECTED_PRESENT\n'; exit 1; else printf 'TEMP_TRANSFER_KEY=ABSENT\n'; fi
set -a; . /root/ldap-directory-reader.credentials; set +a
out=$(ldapsearch -LLL -x -H "$LDAPURI" -D "$LDAPBINDDN" -w "$LDAPBINDPW" -b "$LDAPBASE" '(uid=morgan)' cn sn mail employeeNumber)
printf 'FINAL_READER_NAME=%s\n' "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^cn: Morgan Lake$')"
printf 'FINAL_READER_MAIL=%s\n' "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^mail: morgan@hr.test$')"
printf 'FINAL_READER_EMPLOYEENUMBER=%s\n' "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^employeeNumber:' || true)"
printf 'FINAL_ANON_EMPLOYEES='; ldapsearch -LLL -x -H "$LDAPURI" -b "$LDAPBASE" '(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)' dn 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^dn:' || true
